question: A man can covers a distance of 90 km in 4 hours. He covers some distance by foot at an average speed of 15 km/hr and the remaining distance on bike at an average speed of 40 km/hr, then find the distance travelled by man on foot.
solution:
Given:

Total distance = 90 km

Total time = 4 hours

Speed when he travelled on foot = 15 km/h

Speed when he travelled on bike = 40 km/h

Concept used:

Time = Distance/Speed 

Calculation:

Let the distance travelled on foot be d.

Time taken on foot + Time taken on bike = Total time taken

⇒ d/15 + (90 – d)/40 = 4

⇒ [d × 40 + 15 × (90 – d)]/600 = 4

⇒ [40d + 1350 – 15d = 2400

⇒ 25d + 1350 = 2400

⇒ 25d = 1050

⇒ d = 42 km

∴ The distance travelled on foot is 42 km.
